name: Katmai National Park
policyReason: Pets are allowed throughout the backcountry; only Brooks Camp bans them in summer.
summary: Pets are allowed in the backcountry under physical control, but not at Brooks Camp from May through October.

excerpts.quote: Pets are allowed in the backcountry but must be under physical control at all times.
Pets and service animals are not allowed within the Brooks Camp Developed Area (BCDA), defined as a 1.5 mile radius from the Brooks Falls Platform, between May 1 and October 31.

dogRules.text: No pets or service animals within 1.5 miles of the Brooks Falls Platform (Brooks Camp), May 1 to October 31.
Elsewhere in the backcountry pets must be under physical control.
